Learn Jasper AI: A breakdown of Jasper’s tools

 

Here is a quick overview of the Jasper platform’s features.

 

Step 1: A quick tour of the Dashboard

 

Jasper’s dashboard is quite simple.

From the dashboard, you can see the latest news or updates and how many credits you’ve used recently.

Also, you will find short-form templates, recipes you’ve created or saved, and long-form editor documents.

Further, you can access your account and settings from the dashboard.

 

Step 2: Jasper Templates

 

Jasper offers a wide range of content templates starting from blog posts to emails to social media posts, and more.

They are pre-made programs to attain a specific, short-form copy. Templates are available on all Jasper plans.
Let’s learn about how jasper templates work.

  1. Firstly, you have to choose the template you want to work with.
  2. Then, you need to input your blog post title and product description or benefits of the product.
  3. Further, set the tone of voice and select how many different outputs you want.
  4. When you’re ready hit “Generate AI Content” and Jasper will start generating outputs.
  5. You can copy them, star them, or regenerate more outputs with those outputs.

 

Step 3: Jasper Long-Form Document Editor

 

It’s an AI-powered writing document that makes it easy to write long-form content.

Let’s learn about how jasper long-form document editor work.

  1. Firstly, you need to click “Documents” and then “New“.
  2. Then, you need to fill in the title and content description.
  3. Further, set the tone of voice and input your keywords.
  4. Also, you need to select the output length.
  5. Then, you need to use Jasper commands.
  6. Finally, click on the “Compose” button to quickly tell Jasper to start writing.

Step 4: Jasper Recipes

 

It is one of the latest features that allow you to take AI-generating power to a whole new level.

Jasper Recipes are community-made templates for different types of content.

You can deploy it into the long-form editor only.

Also, you can create and save your own recipes.

Are you ready to learn how to use Jasper AI Recipes? Let’s get right into it.

 

  1. Firstly, you need to click “Recipes” and then “New“.
  2. Further, fill in the title and description of your recipe.
  3. Then, write your Jasper commands and save them.
  4. You can deploy the recipe to the long-form editor.
  5. Once you run the recipe, go through the recipe and replace the variables you created.
  6. Finally, run the Jasper commands you wrote.

 

Bonus: Jasper Boss Mode

 

Jasper Boss Mode is a must-have for long-form content creators. Boss Mode is a premium subscription of Jasper. It makes content creation easy and fast.

Boss Mode gives access to exclusive features to help you get the most out of the software. It unlocks the long-form assistant allowing you to write full blog posts, marketing emails, or even entire books.

You also get an in-built grammar-checking software. With Boss Mode, you will unlock the compose button.

The Boss Mode also lets you use Jasper Commands easily. Jasper Boss Mode works like a boss for even faster writing.

Also, by watching Jasper tutorial boss mode you can learn how to use Jasper.AI Boss Mode.

 

Jasper Writing Assistant: Tips and Tricks for Making Jasper Work Better

 

Jasper is the best AI tool to produce quality content.

But figuring out how to produce good content is very important.

Here are some useful tips for making Jasper work better and faster.

1. Think of Jasper as an Assistant

Jasper doesn’t work like a one-click tool.

You can’t be fully dependent on it, rather think of it as an assistant.

Jasper won’t know what you know until you give it any details.

You need to give specific instructions to make Jasper work properly.

2. Constantly Edit and Delete Jasper’s Work

It’s very important to edit Jasper’s output as you go.

Collect information and format the content first.

Further, delete all bad or unnecessary content.

Then, give Jasper details to help keep it focused and create outputs.

3. Limit Jasper Outputs to 1 or 2

Jasper gives users 3 outputs by default when you hit compose.

It’s a great quick option but will eat up tons of word credits.

So, you should limit outputs to 1 or 2, to save credits.

4. Always Use Built-in Plagiarism Checker

The most important tip you should never forget.

Jasper’s built-in plagiarism checker is way more accurate than free online checkers.

You must run the checker, especially if you haven’t been editing the outputs constantly.

It will find and show you plagiarized content.

Start following these tips and realize how well Jasper works!
